title: The Night Raiders
changes: Seven named Night Raiders now ride by night: cloaked riders on dark horses with massive weapons, always at the act's top level.
In Oakvale's lands one rides only rarely, and alone. In the desert they come more often, and two may ride at once.
They wander the land searching for what they lost, cut down every living thing they meet and leave the dead alone.
Beat one and it falls to dust, leaving rich loot. At dawn they ride off into the dark.
